decisions: Do not optimize ordinary row access for this startup delay: recorded reads and writes are tens of milliseconds in the illustrated captures. Opens and pre-attachment schema operations are excluded from those counters.

Prioritize demand loading of Monaco and unused shared UI entry points; preserve local worker loading, shared module identity and editor behavior. The initial static graph contains 4,260,371 bytes of Monaco, but its isolated startup cost is unmeasured.
Overlap initial renderer loading with backend initialization through an explicit connection/readiness lifecycle; preserve startup error handling, authentication, deadlines and usable-chat completion.
Inspect remaining view/editor initialization after those changes, using CPU and layout attribution; preserve the same fifty-message completion criterion.
Keep Go/Rust as options for demonstrated CPU-heavy components. Current evidence does not justify a rewrite of the backend or build tooling as the first startup optimization.
